verified.note: Confirmed: no CurrencyBalance schema in lib/Settings/shillinq_register.json (51 schemas pre-existing, none named CurrencyBalance) and no multi-currency capability declared elsewhere. ADR-000 already had stub BankAccount + CurrencyBalance entries (no Primary spec citation, minimal fields) — refined in task 11. T3 treasury alignment per ADR-001.

Confirmed: no pre-existing BankAccount schema in any fragment or the monolith — only 'bankAccount' as a string-typed property on treasury-ihb schemas. Zero conflict — declared BankAccount + primaryCurrency freshly in the new fragment with required=[accountName,iban] and primaryCurrency optional (REQ-MC-002 backward-compat).

Existing spec.md at change root retained verbatim (REQ-MC-001..005 with #### Scenario blocks); mirrored into specs/bookkeeping-multi-currency/spec.md for the openspec delta-discovery path (5 requirements, 11 scenarios, RFC 2119 keywords, ADR-022 / ADR-031 citations).

Existing proposal (150 lines) carries Affected Projects + Scope (in/out) + Approach + New Dependencies + Impact + Cross-Project Dependencies + Risks (stale snapshots, missing primaryCurrency, balance timing) + Rollback Strategy + Open Questions (single-vs-multi snapshot, auto-capture cadence, aggregation layer). Cites nextcloud-app shared spec.

Existing design (155 lines) carries Context + Goals + Non-Goals + Decisions D1-D5 (BankAccount.primaryCurrency declaration, snapshot-based CurrencyBalance, optional field, no-balance-calculation, manifest navigation) + Reuse Analysis table + Seed Data (EUR/USD/GBP) + Architectural Alignment + Migration + Rollback.

BankAccount declared with required=[accountName,iban]; primaryCurrency optional string with pattern=^[A-Z]{3}$ (ISO 4217); REQ-MC-001 backward-compat preserved (primaryCurrency NOT in required); x-openregister-audit-trail enabled.

CurrencyBalance declared with all 6 REQ-MC-003 fields (balanceId, accountId FK->BankAccount.slug, currency ISO 4217 pattern, balance, previousBalance optional, lastUpdated); required=[balanceId,accountId,currency,balance,lastUpdated]; (accountId, currency) uniqueness invariant documented in description; x-openregister-audit-trail enabled with audit-trail-immutable rationale recorded.

REQ-MC-004 filters ride the native OpenRegister _filter engine (no custom PHP). Manifest CurrencyBalances index declares accountId + currency filters; balance-range gte/lte are native to the OR query engine (?balance[gte]=20000) so no schema-level wiring needed. Multi-account aggregation across currencies is declared as x-openregister-aggregations.balanceByCurrency (groupBy=[currency], sum(balance)->totalBalance, count->accountCount) — declarative replacement for a custom PHP aggregator (ADR-031).

6 seed objects: 3 BankAccount (bank-eur-op EUR ABN AMRO NL23ABNA0123456789, bank-usd-exp USD Rabobank NL45RABO9876543210, bank-gbp-trd GBP Bunq NL67BUNQ1234567890) + 3 CurrencyBalance snapshots (bal-eur-2026-05-21 EUR 45230.50, bal-usd-2026-05-21 USD 18750.00, bal-gbp-2026-05-21 GBP 12340.75) — exactly matches design.md Seed Data tables. @self envelope with register=shillinq, schema=BankAccount|CurrencyBalance, slug-keyed for ADR-001 idempotency.

Manifest fragment adds 4 pages — BankAccounts (index), BankAccountDetail (detail), CurrencyBalances (index: columns account/currency/balance/previousBalance/lastUpdated, sortable + filterable by accountId + currency), CurrencyBalanceDetail (detail). Two menu entries under Bookkeeping (Bank Accounts + Currency Balances) — closest existing top-level to the spec's 'Cash & Bank' label. Pre-existing src/manifest.json baseline already fails validate-manifest.js (154 Ajv errors fleet-wide); our fragment adds 4 unique page ids with no new validation errors when measured against the merged result.

BankAccount section refined: declares the optional additive primaryCurrency field (REQ-MC-002, nullable with default-EUR semantics per REQ-MC-001), adds administrationId / lifecycleState / notes properties, Primary spec citation to bookkeeping-multi-currency. CurrencyBalance section refined: explicit accountId FK to BankAccount.slug, (accountId, currency) uniqueness, audit-trail-immutable rationale (REQ-AT-001), notes property, declarative aggregation note for REQ-MC-004. Relation: BankAccount -> CurrencyBalance (one-to-many).

16 nl + en translation keys per ADR-007: Currency Balances / Wisselkoersen-saldi, Currency Balance / Wisselkoers-saldo, Bank Accounts / Bankrekeningen, Bank Account / Bankrekening, Account / Rekening, Currency / Valuta, Balance / Saldo, Previous Balance / Vorig saldo, Last Updated / Laatst bijgewerkt, Change / Mutatie, Liquidity Low Warning / Waarschuwing lage liquiditeit, EUR / USD / GBP (verbatim), Primary Currency / Primaire valuta, Multi-currency Account / Multi-valuta rekening. Both l10n files now hold 1007 keys (parity).

unit.note: Runs green in NC container PHP 8.3 PHPUnit 10.5. Covers fragment JSON validity, BankAccount.primaryCurrency optionality + ISO 4217 pattern, CurrencyBalance REQ-MC-003 field set + (accountId, currency) required-set, both schemas enable x-openregister-audit-trail, balanceByCurrency aggregation shape, additive merge over the full register.d chain keeps sibling + monolith schemas, seed coverage of EUR / USD / GBP + FK-resolution to seeded BankAccount slugs, and (accountId, currency) seed uniqueness.

preexisting_issues_observed: openspec validate is non-zero on every shillinq change folder — fleet-wide condition (uses ### REQ-XX-NNN: instead of ### Requirement:); not in scope to fix in this change.

tests/validate-manifest.js reports 154 Ajv errors on the pre-existing src/manifest.json (additionalProperties on menu entries, enum mismatches on field types) — pre-existing fleet condition; our manifest fragment introduces no new errors when measured against the merged manifest.
tests/validate-registers.js reports 193 schemas missing x-openregister-audit-trail.enabled=true — pre-existing fleet condition; our two new schemas DO carry audit-trail.

13 phpunit failures + 2 errors on the development-branch baseline (VatBtwFilingFragmentTest, WidgetServiceTest, AdministrationMigrationService, CashflowForecastFragment, PipelinqTimelineAuth, RetainerBilling, BookingsConfirmFlow) — orthogonal to multi-currency; each requires a dedicated investigation in its own change.
